title.zh: 卷九十四 志第四十七 河渠四
title.raw: 卷九十四 志第四十七 河渠四 Volume 94 Treatises 47: Rivers and Canals 4

sentences.zh: 汴河 下洛河 蔡河 廣濟河 金水河 白溝河 京畿溝渠 白河 三白渠 鄧許諸渠附

translations.literal: Bian River, Xialuo River, Cai River, Guangji River, Jinshui River, Baigou River, capital-region canals and ditches, Bai River, Sanbai Canal, canals of Deng and Xu appended
translations.idiomatic: The Bian River; the Xialuo River; the Cai River; the Guangji River; the Jinshui River; the Baigou River; canals and ditches of the capital region; the Bai River; the Sanbai Canal; and the canals of Deng and Xu, appended

sentences.zh: 元豐元年五月，西頭供奉官張從惠復言：「汴口歲開閉，修堤防，通漕才二百餘日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Yuanfeng year 1, Western Palace Attendant Zhang Conghui again memorialized: "The Bian mouth is opened and closed each year, dikes are repaired, and grain transport is open only a little over two hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Yuanfeng, Zhang Conghui, an attendant of the Western Palace, again submitted a memorial: "Each year the Bian mouth is opened and closed, dikes are maintained, and the grain transport channel is navigable for only a little more than two hundred days.

sentences.zh: 往時數有建議引洛水入汴，患黃河齧廣武山，須鑿山嶺十數丈，以通汴渠，功大不可為。

translations.literal: In the past proposals were made several times to draw Luo River water into the Bian, but they feared the Yellow River would erode Guangwu Mountain, requiring cutting through mountain ridges by several dozen zhang to connect to the Bian canal — too great an undertaking.
translations.idiomatic: In the past there had been repeated proposals to divert the Luo River into the Bian, but the fear was that the Yellow River would gnaw at Guangwu Mountain and that connecting the Bian canal would require cutting through ridges by several dozen zhang — a project too vast to undertake.

sentences.zh: 去年七月，黃河暴漲，水落而稍北，距廣武山麓七里，退灘高闊，可鑿為渠，引洛入汴。」

translations.literal: Last year in the seventh month the Yellow River rose violently; when the water fell it shifted somewhat north, seven li from the foot of Guangwu Mountain, with a broad, high exposed bank where a canal could be cut to draw the Luo into the Bian."
translations.idiomatic: Last July the Yellow River surged; when the flood subsided the channel shifted slightly northward, standing seven li from the foot of Guangwu Mountain, where a broad, elevated stretch of exposed bank offered ground on which a canal could be cut to bring the Luo into the Bian."

sentences.zh: 范子淵知都水監丞，畫十利以獻。

translations.literal: Fan Ziyuan, acting Director of the Directorate of Waterways, drew up ten benefits and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ziyuan, acting director of the Directorate of Waterways, drafted a plan setting forth ten benefits and submitted it.

sentences.zh: 又言：「汜水出玉仙山，索水出嵩渚山，合洛水，積其廣深，得二千一百三十六尺，視今汴流尚贏九百七十四尺。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Si River rises at Yuxian Mountain, the Suo River rises at Songzhu Mountain; together with the Luo they yield a combined width and depth of 2,136 chi, which still exceeds the present Bian flow by 974 chi.
translations.idiomatic: He also stated: "The Si River issues from Yuxian Mountain and the Suo River from Songzhu Mountain; combined with the Luo, their aggregate width and depth amount to 2,136 chi — still 974 chi more than the present volume of the Bian channel.

sentences.zh: 以河、洛湍緩不同，得其贏餘，可以相補。

translations.literal: Because the Yellow River and the Luo differ in swiftness and slowness, their surplus can compensate for each other.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Yellow River and the Luo differ in the speed of their currents, the surplus from one can offset the shortfall of the other.

sentences.zh: 猶慮不足，則旁堤為塘，滲取河水，每百里置木閘一，以限水勢。

translations.literal: If still insufficient, embankments on either side would be made into ponds to seep and draw river water; every hundred li one wooden sluice gate would be set to restrain the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: If there were still concern of insufficient flow, ponds could be formed along the dikes to draw off river water by seepage, and a wooden sluice gate could be installed every hundred li to regulate the force of the current.

sentences.zh: 兩旁溝、湖、陂、濼，皆可引以為助，禁伊、洛上源私引水者。

translations.literal: Ditches, lakes, embankment ponds, and marshlands on both sides could all be drawn upon for assistance; private diversion of water from the upper reaches of the Yi and Luo would be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Ditches, lakes, embankment ponds, and marshlands on either side could all be tapped as supplementary sources, while private diversion of water from the upper reaches of the Yi and Luo would be prohibited.

sentences.zh: 大約汴舟重載，入水不過四尺，今深五尺，可濟漕運。

translations.literal: Roughly, Bian boats when heavily laden draw no more than four chi of water; now at five chi depth, grain transport could be sustained.
translations.idiomatic: As a rule, heavily laden Bian boats draw no more than four chi of water; at a depth of five chi, the grain transport could be sustained.

sentences.zh: 起鞏縣神尾山，至土家堤，築大堤四十七里，以捍大河。

translations.literal: From Shenwei Mountain in Gong County to Tujia Embankment, a great dike forty-seven li long would be built to hold back the great river.
translations.idiomatic: From Shenwei Mountain in Gong County to the Tujia Embankment, a great dike forty-seven li in length would be constructed to hold back the main river.

sentences.zh: 起沙谷至河陰縣十里店，穿渠五十二里，引洛水屬於汴渠。」

translations.literal: From Shagu to Shilidian in Heyin County, a canal fifty-two li long would be cut to lead the Luo water into the Bian canal."
translations.idiomatic: From Shagu to Shilidian in Heyin County, a canal fifty-two li long would be excavated to connect the Luo River to the Bian canal."

sentences.zh: 疏奏，上重其事，遣使行視。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the emperor regarded the matter as weighty and dispatched envoys to inspect on site.
translations.idiomatic: After the memorial was submitted, the emperor treated the proposal as a matter of great importance and sent envoys to conduct an on-site inspection.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，使還，以為工費浩大，不可為。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 2 the envoys returned and judged the labor costs too vast — it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year the envoys returned and reported that the labor costs would be prohibitive and that the project could not be undertaken.

sentences.zh: 上復遣入內供奉宋用臣，還奏可為，請「自任村沙穀口至汴口開河五十里，引伊、洛水入汴河，每二十里置束水一，以芻楗為之，以節湍急之勢，取水深一丈，以通漕運。

translations.literal: The emperor again dispatched Inner Palace Attendant Song Yongchen, who on his return reported that it could be done and requested: "From Rencun Shagu mouth to the Bian mouth, open a river fifty li long, drawing Yi and Luo water into the Bian River; every twenty li set one water restraint, made of straw fascines, to moderate the force of rapids; take a depth of one zhang to open grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again dispatched Song Yongchen, an attendant of the Inner Palace, who on his return reported that the work was feasible and requested: "From the mouth at Rencun Shagu to the Bian mouth, excavate a channel fifty li long to bring the waters of the Yi and Luo into the Bian River; every twenty li install a water restraint built of straw fascines to temper the force of the rapids; maintain a depth of one zhang to sustain the grain transport.

sentences.zh: 引古索河為源，注房家、黃家、孟家三陂及三十六陂，高仰處瀦水為塘，以備洛水不足，則決以入河。

translations.literal: Draw the ancient Suo River as source, pour into the Fang, Huang, and Meng family ponds and thirty-six ponds; where the land rises, impound water in ponds as reserve — when the Luo was insufficient, breach them to let water into the river.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient Suo River would serve as the source, feeding the Fang, Huang, and Meng family reservoirs and thirty-six other ponds; on higher ground water would be impounded in ponds as a reserve — when the Luo proved insufficient, these would be breached to release water into the channel.

sentences.zh: 又自汜水關北開河五百五十步，屬於黃河，上下置閘啟閉，以通黃、汴二河船筏。

translations.literal: Also north of Sishui Pass open a river five hundred fifty bu long connecting to the Yellow River, with sluice gates above and below opened and closed to link boats and rafts of the Yellow and Bian rivers.
translations.idiomatic: North of Sishui Pass a channel five hundred fifty paces long would also be opened to connect with the Yellow River, with sluice gates installed upstream and downstream that could be opened and closed to allow vessels and rafts to pass between the Yellow and Bian rivers.

sentences.zh: 即洛河舊口置水笧，通黃河，以泄伊、洛暴漲。

translations.literal: At the old mouth of the Luo River set a water sluice connecting to the Yellow River to discharge violent floods of the Yi and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: At the old mouth of the Luo River a water sluice would be installed to connect with the Yellow River, providing an outlet for sudden floods on the Yi and Luo.

sentences.zh: 古索河等暴漲，即以魏樓、滎澤、孔固三斗門泄之。

translations.literal: When the ancient Suo River and others rose violently, discharge them through the three sluice gates at Weilou, Xingze, and Konggu.
translations.idiomatic: When the ancient Suo River and related streams surged, the flood would be discharged through the three sluice gates at Weilou, Xingze, and Konggu.

sentences.zh: 計工九十萬七千有餘。

translations.literal: Labor was calculated at more than 907,000 [units].
translations.idiomatic: The labor requirement was estimated at more than 907,000 work units.

sentences.zh: 仍乞修護黃河南堤埽，以防侵奪新河」。

translations.literal: He also requested repair and protection of the south Yellow River dike revetments to guard against encroachment on the new river."
translations.idiomatic: He further requested that the revetments on the south bank of the Yellow River be repaired and maintained to prevent the new channel from being overrun."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 徽宗二月，都水監言：惠民河修簽河次下硬堰畢工。

translations.literal: In the second month under Huizong, the Directorate of Waterworks reported that repair of the spur channel and lower hard weir on the Huimin River had been completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month under Huizong, the Directorate of Waterworks reported that repair of the spur channel and lower hard weir on the Huimin River had been completed.

sentences.zh: 詔立捕獲盜泄賞。

translations.literal: An edict established rewards for capturing those who stole or released water illicitly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established rewards for capturing those who stole or released water illicitly.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年十二月，開潩河入蔡河，從京畿都轉運使吳擇仁之請也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Daguan, the Yi River was opened into the Cai River at the request of Wu Zeren, metropolitan transport commissioner of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Daguan, the Yi River was opened into the Cai River at the request of Wu Zeren, metropolitan transport commissioner of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 政和元年十月己酉，詔差水官同京畿監司視蔡河堤防及淤淺者，來春並工治之。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the tenth month of the first year of Zhenghe, an edict assigned water officials together with metropolitan inspectors to examine Cai River dikes and banks and silted stretches, all to be repaired together in the coming spring.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the tenth month of the first year of Zhenghe, an edict assigned water officials together with metropolitan inspectors to examine Cai River dikes and banks and silted stretches, all to be repaired together in the coming spring.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，以用臣都大提舉導洛通汴。

translations.literal: On gengyin day of the third month, Yongchen was appointed Grand Director for Guiding the Luo and Opening the Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month, Song Yongchen was appointed chief commissioner for the project to guide the Luo River into the Bian.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子興工，遣禮官祭告。

translations.literal: On jiazi day of the fourth month work commenced; ritual officials were sent to offer sacrifices and announce it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fourth month construction began, and officials of the Ministry of Rites were dispatched to perform sacrificial rites and announce the undertaking.

sentences.zh: 河道侵民塚墓，給錢徙之，無主者，官為瘞藏。

translations.literal: Where the channel encroached on commoners' tombs and graves, money was given to relocate them; where there were no owners, the government buried and stored the remains.
translations.idiomatic: Where the channel route encroached on private graves, compensation was paid for relocation; where there was no claimant, the authorities undertook proper burial.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，清汴成，凡用工四十五日。

translations.literal: On wushen day of the sixth month the Clear Bian project was completed, labor totaling forty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the sixth month the Clear Bian project was completed, having required forty-five days of labor in all.

sentences.zh: 自任村沙口至河陰縣瓦亭子；

translations.literal: From Rencun Shagou mouth to Watingzi in Heyin County;
translations.idiomatic: From the mouth at Rencun Shagou to Watingzi in Heyin County;

sentences.zh: 并汜水關北通黃河：接運河，長五十一里。

translations.literal: and north of Sishui Pass connecting to the Yellow River: joining the transport canal, fifty-one li in length.
translations.idiomatic: together with the connection north of Sishui Pass to the Yellow River: linking the transport canal for a total length of fifty-one li.

sentences.zh: 兩岸為堤，總長一百三里，引洛水入汴。

translations.literal: Dikes were built on both banks, totaling one hundred three li in length, drawing Luo water into the Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes were constructed on both banks for a combined length of one hundred three li, bringing the waters of the Luo into the Bian.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，閉汴口，徙官吏、河清卒於新洛口。

translations.literal: On jiazi day of the seventh month the Bian mouth was closed; officials and River-Clearing corvée laborers were transferred to the new Luo mouth.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the seventh month the old Bian mouth was closed, and officials together with the River-Clearing corvée troops were reassigned to the new Luo mouth.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遣禮官致祭。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, ritual officials were sent to perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, officials of the Ministry of Rites were dispatched to offer sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，詔差七千人，赴汴口開修河道。

translations.literal: On xinwei day of the eleventh month an edict dispatched seven thousand men to the Bian mouth to open and repair the channel.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the eleventh month an edict assigned seven thousand laborers to the Bian mouth to open and repair the channel.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，宋用臣言：「洛水入汴至淮，河道漫闊，多淺澀，乞狹河六十里，為二十一萬六千步。」

translations.literal: In the second month of year 3 Song Yongchen said: "From where the Luo enters the Bian to the Huai, the channel is broad and shallow in many places; I request narrowing the river for sixty li, amounting to 216,000 bu."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year Song Yongchen reported: "From the point where the Luo joins the Bian to the Huai, the channel is excessively wide and shallow in many stretches; I request that the river be narrowed over sixty li, a distance of 216,000 paces."

sentences.zh: 以四月興役。

translations.literal: Labor was begun in the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: Work was initiated in the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，罷草屯浮堰。

translations.literal: On guihai day of the fifth month the Caotun floating weir was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the fifth month the floating weir at Caotun was dismantled.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，宋用臣言：「金水河透水槽阻礙上下汴舟，宜廢撤。」

translations.literal: In the third month of year 5 Song Yongchen said: "The Jinshui River's overflow trough obstructs Bian boats going up and down; it should be abolished and removed."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year Song Yongchen reported: "The overflow trough on the Jinshui River obstructs vessels traveling up and down the Bian; it should be dismantled."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十月，狹河畢工。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the river-narrowing work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the river-narrowing project was completed.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，范子淵又請「于武濟山麓至河岸並嫩灘上修堤及壓埽堤，又新河南岸築新堤，計役兵六千人，二百日成。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 6 Fan Ziyuan again requested: "From the foot of Wuji Mountain to the riverbank and on the tender shoals, repair dikes and pressing-revetment dikes; also on the south bank of the new river build a new dike — estimated corvée soldiers six thousand, completion in two hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year Fan Ziyuan again petitioned: "From the foot of Wuji Mountain to the riverbank and across the tender shoals, repair the dikes and pressing-revetment works; on the south bank of the new channel construct a new dike as well — requiring an estimated six thousand corvée troops and two hundred days to complete.

sentences.zh: 開展直河，長六十三里，廣一百尺，深一丈，役兵四萬七千有奇，一月成。」

translations.literal: Open and straighten the river, sixty-three li long, one hundred chi wide, one zhang deep — corvée soldiers 47,000 odd, completion in one month."
translations.idiomatic: Excavate and straighten the channel for a length of sixty-three li, a width of one hundred chi, and a depth of one zhang — requiring somewhat more than forty-seven thousand corvée troops and one month to finish."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十月，都提舉司言：「汴水增漲，京西四斗門不能分減，致開決堤岸。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Grand Directorate reported: "The Bian water has risen; the four sluice gates west of the capital cannot divide and reduce it, causing breaches in the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the chief directorate reported: "The Bian has risen sharply; the four sluice gates west of the capital cannot divert enough water, with the result that the dikes have been breached.

sentences.zh: 今近京惟孔固斗門可以泄水下入黃河。

translations.literal: At present near the capital only the Konggu sluice gate can discharge water down into the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: At present, of the gates near the capital only the Konggu sluice can release water downstream into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 若孫賈斗門雖可泄入廣濟，然下尾窄狹，不能盡吞。

translations.literal: Although the Sunjia sluice gate can discharge into the Guangji, its lower reach is narrow and cannot take it all.
translations.idiomatic: Although the Sunjia sluice can divert water into the Guangji River, the lower reach is too narrow to absorb the full volume.

sentences.zh: 宜於萬勝鎮舊減水河、汴河北岸修立斗門，開淘舊河，創開生河一道，下合入刁馬河，役夫一萬三千六百四十三人，一月畢工。」

translations.literal: It is fitting at Wansheng Town's old flood-reduction river and on the north bank of the Bian to build sluice gates, dredge the old river, and open a new channel one route, joining below into the Diaoma River — laborers 13,643, completion in one month."
translations.idiomatic: Sluice gates should be built at the old flood-reduction channel at Wansheng Town and on the north bank of the Bian; the old river should be dredged and a new channel excavated to discharge into the Diaoma River below — requiring 13,643 laborers and one month to complete."

sentences.zh: 詔從其請，仍作二年開修。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request, scheduling opening and repair for year 2.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request and scheduled the opening and repair work for the second year.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，武濟河潰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 7 the Wuji River breached.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year the Wuji River broke through its banks.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔罷營閉，縱其分流，止護廣武三埽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month an edict halted construction and closure, allowing it to divide and flow, protecting only the three Guangwu revetments.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict halted efforts to dam and close the breach, allowing the river to divide and flow freely while directing protection only to the three Guangwu revetments.

sentences.zh: 哲宗元祐元年閏二月辛亥，右司諫蘇轍言：「近歲京城外創置水磨，因此汴水淺澀，阻隔官私舟船。

translations.literal: On xinhai day of the intercalary second month of Yuanyou year 1 of Emperor Zhezong, Right Remonstrator Su Zhe said: "In recent years water mills were established outside the capital; because of this the Bian water has become shallow and obstructed, blocking official and private boats.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the intercalary second month of the first year of Yuanyou under Emperor Zhezong, Su Zhe, Right Remonstrator of the Secretariat, submitted a memorial: "In recent years water-powered mills have been established outside the capital; as a result the Bian has grown shallow and sluggish, obstructing both official and private vessels.

sentences.zh: 其東門外水磨，下流汗漫無歸，浸損民田一二百里，幾敗漢高祖墳。

translations.literal: The water mills outside the east gate — their outflow spreads without return, inundating and damaging commoners' fields for one or two hundred li, nearly destroying the tomb of Emperor Gaozu of Han.
translations.idiomatic: The mills outside the east gate discharge water that spreads without channel or outlet, flooding and ruining private fields across one or two hundred li and nearly undermining the tomb of Emperor Gaozu of Han.

sentences.zh: 賴陛下仁聖惻怛，親發德音，令執政共議營救。

translations.literal: Thanks to Your Majesty's benevolence and compassion, you personally issued a gracious edict ordering the chief ministers to deliberate jointly on relief.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to Your Majesty's benevolence and compassion, you personally issued an edict of grace directing the chief ministers to deliberate jointly on measures of relief.

sentences.zh: 尋詔畿縣于黃河春夫外，更調夫四萬，開自盟河，以疏泄水患，計一月畢工。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered the capital districts, beyond the Yellow River spring corvée, to levy an additional forty thousand laborers to open from the Meng River to drain the flood — estimated completion in one month.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter an edict directed the capital districts, in addition to the spring corvée for the Yellow River, to levy a further forty thousand laborers to open a channel from the Meng River to drain off the floodwaters — estimated to require one month.

sentences.zh: 然以水磨供給京城內外食茶等，其水止得五日閉斷，以此工役重大，民間每夫日顧二百錢，一月之費，計二百四十萬貫。

translations.literal: Yet because the water mills supply food and tea inside and outside the capital, their water could be cut off only five days; because of this the labor was great — among the people each laborer was paid two hundred cash per day; one month's cost totaled 2.4 million strings.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because the mills supply grain and tea to the capital and its suburbs, the water could be cut off for only five days; the project was therefore enormous in scale — each laborer received two hundred cash per day from private funds, and the cost for one month came to 2.4 million strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 而汴水渾濁，易至填淤，明年又須開淘，民間歲歲不免此費。

translations.literal: Moreover the Bian water is turbid and easily silts up; next year dredging must be done again — the people cannot escape this expense year after year.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Bian is turbid and silts up easily; dredging must be undertaken again the following year — year after year the populace cannot escape this burden.

sentences.zh: 聞水磨歲入不過四十萬貫，前戶部侍郎李定以此課利，惑誤朝聽，依舊存留。

translations.literal: I hear the water mills' annual revenue does not exceed 400,000 strings; the former Vice Minister of Revenue Li Ding, for this tax profit, misled the court's hearing and had them retained as before.
translations.idiomatic: I understand that the mills yield no more than 400,000 strings annually; the former Vice Minister of Revenue Li Ding, citing this revenue, misled the court and secured their retention.

sentences.zh: 且水磨興置未久，自前未有此錢，國計何闕？

translations.literal: Moreover the water mills were established not long ago; before this there was no such money — what does the state budget lack?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the mills were established only recently; before their creation this revenue did not exist — what gap would their abolition leave in the state budget?

sentences.zh: 而小人淺陋，妄有靳惜，傷民辱國，不以為愧。

translations.literal: Yet petty men, shallow and base, presumptuously stint, harming the people and shaming the state without feeling shame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet petty officials, shallow and narrow-minded, cling to this revenue without scruple, harming the people and shaming the state yet feeling no shame.

sentences.zh: 況今水患近在國門，而恬不為怪，甚非陛下勤恤民物之意。

translations.literal: Moreover today's flood disaster is right at the capital gates, yet they are unconcerned as if it were nothing strange — this greatly fails to accord with Your Majesty's diligent care for the people's welfare.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the flood now threatens the very gates of the capital, yet they treat it as unremarkable — a response utterly at odds with Your Majesty's diligent concern for the people's welfare.

sentences.zh: 而又減耗汴水，行船不便。

translations.literal: Furthermore they deplete the Bian water, making travel by boat inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: They further deplete the waters of the Bian, impeding navigation.

sentences.zh: 乞廢罷官磨，任民磨茶。」

translations.literal: I beg to abolish the official mills and let the people grind tea themselves."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the official mills be abolished and that the people be permitted to grind their own tea."

sentences.zh: 三月，轍又乞「令汴口以東州縣，各具水匱所占頃畝，每歲有無除放二稅，仍具水匱可與不可廢罷，如決不可廢，當如何給還民田，以免怨望。」

translations.literal: In the third month Zhe again requested: "Order the prefectures and counties east of the Bian mouth each to report the mu occupied by water storage ponds, whether the two taxes are remitted each year, and whether the ponds can or cannot be abolished; if they absolutely cannot be abolished, how private fields should be compensated to avoid resentment."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Su Zhe again petitioned: "Let each prefecture and county east of the Bian mouth report the acreage occupied by water-storage ponds, whether the land tax has been remitted each year, and whether the ponds can be abolished; if abolition is impossible, let them specify how private fields are to be compensated so as to forestall popular resentment."

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，轍又言：「昨朝旨令都水監差官，具括中牟、管城等縣水匱，元浸壓者幾何，見今積水所占幾何，退出頃畝幾何。

translations.literal: On xinhai day of the eighth month Zhe again said: "Yesterday's court order directed the Directorate of Waterways to dispatch officials to fully account for the water ponds of Zhongmou, Guancheng, and other counties — how much was originally inundated and pressed down, how much present accumulated water occupies, how many mu are to be returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the eighth month Su Zhe again reported: "By yesterday's court order the Directorate of Waterways was to dispatch officials to survey the water-storage ponds of Zhongmou, Guancheng, and other counties — how much land was originally submerged, how much standing water now occupies, and how many mu are to be restored.

sentences.zh: 凡退出之地，皆還本主。

translations.literal: All land returned is to be given back to the original owners.
translations.idiomatic: All restored land is to be returned to its original owners.

sentences.zh: 水占者，以官地還之；

translations.literal: Where water occupies land, compensate with government land;
translations.idiomatic: Where land remains under water, compensate with government land;

sentences.zh: 無田可還，即給元直。

translations.literal: where no land can be returned, give the original price.
translations.idiomatic: where no land is available, pay the original purchase price.

sentences.zh: 聖恩深厚，棄利與民，所存甚遠。

translations.literal: The sage grace is profound — abandoning profit for the people, the purpose is far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Your sage grace is profound in abandoning revenue for the people's sake — a policy whose benefits will endure.

sentences.zh: 然臣聞水所占地，至今無可對還，而退出之田，亦以迫近水匱，為雨水浸淫，未得耕鑿。

translations.literal: Yet I hear the land occupied by water still has nothing with which to compensate; and the returned fields, because they border the water ponds, are soaked by rain and have not been plowed or dug.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I am told that the submerged land still cannot be matched with equivalent compensation, and that the fields nominally restored remain adjacent to the ponds, soaked by rain, and still uncultivated.

sentences.zh: 知鄭州岑象求近奏稱： '自宋用臣興置水匱以來，元未曾取以灌注，清汴水流自足，不廢漕運。

translations.literal: The prefect of Zhengzhou Cen Xiangqiu recently memorialized: 'Since Song Yongchen established the water ponds, they have never actually been drawn upon for irrigation; the Clear Bian flow is sufficient on its own without impairing grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Xiangqiu, prefect of Zhengzhou, recently memorialized: 'Since Song Yongchen established the water-storage ponds, they have never in fact been tapped for irrigation; the Clear Bian flow is ample on its own and grain transport has not suffered."

sentences.zh: '乞盡廢水匱，以便失業之民。」

translations.literal: I beg to abolish the water ponds entirely to relieve the people who have lost their livelihood."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the ponds be abolished entirely so that those who have lost their livelihood may be relieved."

sentences.zh: 十月，遂罷水匱。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the water ponds were then abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the water-storage ponds were accordingly abolished.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，御史中丞梁燾言：

translations.literal: In the winter of year 4 Censor-in-Chief Liang Tao said:
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year, Liang Tao, Censor-in-Chief, submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 嘗求世務之急，得導洛通汴之實，始聞其說則可喜，及考其事則可懼。

translations.literal: I once sought what was urgent in worldly affairs and obtained the truth of guiding the Luo and opening the Bian — at first hearing the proposal it was delightful; on examining the matter it is fearful.
translations.idiomatic: I once sought out the most pressing affairs of state and came to understand the reality of the project to guide the Luo into the Bian — at first hearing the proposal it seemed promising, but on examining the facts it proves alarming.

sentences.zh: 竊以廣武山之北，即大河故道，河常往來其間，夏秋漲溢，每抵山下。

translations.literal: I venture that north of Guangwu Mountain is the great river's old course; the river constantly moves back and forth there; in summer and autumn it swells and overflows, each time reaching the foot of the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: North of Guangwu Mountain lies the old course of the great river; the Yellow River has always shifted back and forth across this ground, and in summer and autumn its floods regularly reach the foot of the mountain.

sentences.zh: 舊來洛水至此，流入於河。

translations.literal: Formerly when the Luo reached here it flowed into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, when the Luo reached this point, it discharged into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 後欲導以趨汴渠，乃乘河未漲，就嫩灘之上，峻起東西堤，辟大河於堤北，攘其地以引洛水，中間缺為斗門，名通舟楫，其實盜河以助洛之淺涸也。

translations.literal: Later, wishing to guide it toward the Bian canal, they took advantage of when the river had not yet risen, on the tender shoals raised steep east and west dikes, opened the great river north of the dikes, seized its ground to draw Luo water — in the middle a gap made into a sluice gate, named for passing boats, but in truth stealing river water to aid the Luo's shallowness and drying.
translations.idiomatic: Later, wishing to divert the Luo toward the Bian canal, they waited until the Yellow River had not yet risen, then on the tender shoals erected steep dikes east and west, forced the main river north of the dikes, and seized its channel to draw off the Luo — leaving a gap in the middle fitted with a sluice gate said to allow vessels to pass, but in truth appropriating the Yellow River's flow to supplement the shallow, failing Luo.

sentences.zh: 洛水本清，而今汴常黃流，是洛不足以行汴，而所以能行者，附大河之餘波也。

translations.literal: The Luo water is originally clear, but now the Bian is constantly a yellow flow — the Luo is insufficient to sustain the Bian; what enables it to run is riding on the great river's leftover waves.
translations.idiomatic: The Luo is naturally clear, yet the Bian now runs perpetually yellow — proof that the Luo alone cannot sustain the Bian; what keeps the channel navigable is the borrowed surplus of the Yellow River's flow.

sentences.zh: 增廣武三埽之備，竭京西所有，不足以為支費，其失無慮數百萬計。

translations.literal: Increasing the defenses of the three Guangwu revetments, exhausting all that the capital west has — still insufficient for maintenance costs; the losses surely number in the millions.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcing the three Guangwu revetments and exhausting every resource west of the capital still cannot cover the maintenance costs; the losses must run to several million.

sentences.zh: 從來上下習為欺罔，朝廷惑于安流之說，稅屋之利，恬不為慮。

translations.literal: For long above and below have been accustomed to deception; the court was deluded by talk of tranquil flow and the profit of taxing houses, unconcerned and unthinking.
translations.idiomatic: For years officials at every level have grown accustomed to deception; the court was misled by assurances of a stable current and by the revenue from taxing riverside dwellings, and gave the danger no thought.

sentences.zh: 而不知新沙疏弱，力不能制悍河，水勢一薄，則爛熳潰散，將使怒流循洛而下，直冒京師。

translations.literal: Yet they did not know the new sand is loose and weak, its strength unable to control the fierce river — once the water's force thins, it will dissolve and burst apart, making the raging current follow the Luo down and strike straight at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: They failed to see that the new sandbanks are loose and weak, incapable of restraining the fierce river — once the current slackens, the works will crumble and burst, and the raging flood will course down the Luo straight upon the capital.

sentences.zh: 是甘以數百萬日增之費，養異時萬一之患，亦已誤矣。

translations.literal: This is willingly to take millions in daily increasing expense to nurture a one-in-ten-thousand future disaster — already mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: To spend millions that grow daily in order to nurture a catastrophe that may strike at any moment is already a grave error.

sentences.zh: 夫歲傾重費以坐待其患，何若折其奔沖，以終除其害哉。

translations.literal: To pour heavy expense year after year and sit waiting for the disaster — how is that compared to breaking its rushing charge to eliminate the harm once and for all?
translations.idiomatic: What is gained by pouring out heavy sums year after year only to sit and await disaster, when one could break the river's rushing charge and eliminate the threat once and for all?

sentences.zh: 為今之計，宜復為汴口，仍引大河一支，啟閉以時，還祖宗百年以來潤國養民之賜，誠為得策。

translations.literal: For today's plan, the Bian mouth should be restored, still drawing one branch of the great river, opened and closed according to season — returning the hundred-year gift since the ancestors of enriching the state and nourishing the people; truly this is the right strategy.
translations.idiomatic: The proper course today is to restore the Bian mouth, draw off one branch of the great river, and open and close it according to season — thereby recovering the century-old policy by which our ancestors enriched the state and sustained the people. This is truly the sound strategy.

sentences.zh: 汴口復成：則免廣武傾注，以長為京師之安；

translations.literal: If the Bian mouth is restored: then Guangwu's pouring inundation is avoided, securing the capital's safety for long;
translations.idiomatic: If the Bian mouth is restored, the inundation threatening Guangwu is averted and the capital secured for the long term;

sentences.zh: 省數百萬之費，以紓京西生靈之困；

translations.literal: millions in expense are saved, relieving the distress of the living west of the capital;
translations.idiomatic: millions in expenditure are saved and the suffering of the populace west of the capital relieved;

sentences.zh: 牽大河水勢，以解河北決溢之災；

translations.literal: the great river's water force is drawn off, resolving the disaster of breaches and overflows in Hebei;
translations.idiomatic: the force of the great river is drawn off, easing the breaches and floods of Hebei;

sentences.zh: 便東南漕運，以蠲重載留滯之弊；

translations.literal: southeast grain transport is facilitated, remitting the ill of heavily laden boats detained;
translations.idiomatic: southeastern grain transport is facilitated, ending the delays that plague heavily laden vessels;

sentences.zh: 時節啟閉，以除蹙淩打淩之苦；

translations.literal: seasonal opening and closing removes the suffering of crowding and ramming;
translations.idiomatic: seasonal opening and closing removes the crowding and collision that torment boatmen;

sentences.zh: 通江、淮八路商賈大船，以供京師之饒。

translations.literal: great merchant ships of the eight routes of the Yangzi and Huai are connected, supplying the capital's abundance.
translations.idiomatic: great merchant vessels from the eight routes of the Yangzi and Huai are admitted, supplying the capital's abundance.

sentences.zh: 為甚大之利者六，此不可忽也。

translations.literal: These six are very great benefits — this cannot be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: These six are benefits of the greatest magnitude and must not be neglected.

sentences.zh: 惟拆去兩岸舍屋，盡廢僦錢，為害者一而甚小，所謂損小費以成大利也。

translations.literal: Only demolishing houses on both banks and abolishing all rental fees — the harm is one and very small; this is what is called sacrificing small cost to achieve great benefit.
translations.idiomatic: The sole drawback is the demolition of riverside dwellings and the loss of rental revenue — a single harm, and a minor one; this is precisely the principle of sacrificing a small cost to secure a great benefit.

sentences.zh: 臣之所言，特其大略爾。

translations.literal: What your subject has said is only the general outline.
translations.idiomatic: What your subject has set forth is only the broad outline.

sentences.zh: 至於考究本末，措置纖悉，在朝廷擇通習之臣付之，無牽浮議，責其成功。

translations.literal: As for investigating root and branch and arranging every detail — let the court choose a versed minister and entrust it to him, without being pulled by shallow talk, and hold him responsible for success.
translations.idiomatic: As for investigating causes and effects and arranging every detail, let the court select a minister thoroughly versed in these matters, entrust the work to him without yielding to shallow opinion, and hold him accountable for success.

sentences.zh: 又言：

translations.literal: He also said:
translations.idiomatic: He further stated:

sentences.zh: 臣聞開汴之時，大河曠歲不決，蓋汴口析其三分之水，河流常行七分也。

translations.literal: Your subject hears that when the Bian was opened, the great river went years without breaching — for the Bian mouth divided off three-tenths of its water, and the river normally ran seven-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that when the Bian mouth was first opened, the great river went years without breaching, for the Bian diverted three-tenths of its flow while seven-tenths continued down the main channel.

sentences.zh: 自導洛而後，頻年屢決，雖洛口竊取其水，率不過一分上下，是河流常九分也。

translations.literal: Since guiding the Luo, year after year it has breached repeatedly; though the Luo mouth secretly takes its water, on average no more than one-tenth up or down — the river normally runs nine-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Luo was guided in, the river has breached repeatedly year after year; though the Luo mouth diverts some of its water, the amount rarely exceeds one-tenth — leaving nine-tenths on the main course.

sentences.zh: 猶幸流勢臥北，故潰溢北出。

translations.literal: Fortunately the flow's force lies northward, so breaches and overflows exit north.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately the current still trends northward, so breaches and floods have discharged to the north.

sentences.zh: 自去歲以來，稍稍臥南，此其可憂，而洛口之作，理須早計。

translations.literal: Since last year it has gradually lain south — this is worrisome; the Luo mouth project logically must be planned early.
translations.idiomatic: Since last year it has gradually shifted southward — a cause for alarm — and the Luo mouth project must be reconsidered without delay.

sentences.zh: 竊以開洛之役，其功甚小，不比大河之上，但辟百餘步，即可以通水三分，即永為京師之福，又減河北屢決之害；

translations.literal: I venture that opening the Luo project — its work is very small; unlike on the great river, only opening a hundred-odd bu can let through three-tenths of the water — this would forever be the capital's blessing, and also reduce Hebei's repeated breach harm;
translations.idiomatic: I submit that reopening the Bian mouth would require very little labor — unlike works on the great river, a channel of little more than a hundred paces would divert three-tenths of the flow, securing the capital's welfare permanently while easing the repeated breaches in Hebei;

sentences.zh: 兼水勢既已牽動，在於回河尤為順便，非獨孫村之功可成，澶州故道，亦有自然可復之理。

translations.literal: Moreover since the water force is already drawn, for returning the river it is especially convenient — not only can the Sun Village work succeed; the old course at Dazhou also has a natural principle of being restorable.
translations.idiomatic: and once the current is drawn off, diverting the river becomes especially feasible — not only would the Sun Village project succeed, but the old course at Dazhou also has a natural tendency toward restoration.

sentences.zh: 望出臣前章，面詔大臣與本監及知水事者，按地形水勢，具圖以聞。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will issue my former memorial, face-to-face instruct the chief ministers and this directorate and those who know water affairs, survey according to terrain and water force, and submit maps in full report.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Your Majesty circulate my earlier memorial, instruct the chief ministers, this directorate, and those versed in hydraulic affairs to survey the terrain and water conditions, and submit detailed maps for the court's consideration.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No reply was made.
translations.idiomatic: The court took no action.

sentences.zh: 至五年十月癸巳，乃詔導河水入汴。，

translations.literal: In the tenth month on day guisi of the fifth year, an edict was issued to guide river water into the Bian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the guisi day of the fifth year, the court ordered the Yellow River diverted into the Bian Canal.

sentences.zh: 帝親政，復召宋用臣赴闕。

translations.literal: The emperor personally took up government and again summoned Song Yongchen to court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor resumed personal rule and again summoned Song Yongchen to court.

sentences.zh: 七月辛丑，廣武埽危急。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on day xinchou, the Guangwu sáo was in critical danger.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the xinchou day, the Guangwu sáo embankment was in critical danger.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，帝語輔臣：「埽去洛河不遠，須防漲溢下灌京師。」

translations.literal: On day renyin the emperor told his chief ministers: "The sáo is not far from the Luo River; we must guard against flood rise pouring down upon the capital."
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the emperor told his chief ministers: "The sáo is not far from the Luo River; we must guard against rising floods pouring down upon the capital."

sentences.zh: 明日，乃詔都水監丞馮忱之相度築欄水簽堤。

translations.literal: The next day an edict ordered Assistant Director of Waterworks Feng Chen to survey and build spur dikes and water-check embankments.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the court ordered Feng Chen, assistant director of the Directorate of Waterworks, to survey the site and build spur dikes and water-check embankments.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，帝諭執政曰：「河埽久不修，昨日報洛水又大溢，注於河，若廣武埽壞，河、洛為一，則清汴不通矣，京都漕運殊可憂。

translations.literal: On day dingsi the emperor instructed the chief administrators: "The river sáo have long gone unrepaired. Yesterday word came that the Luo had again overflowed greatly and poured into the river. If the Guangwu sáo fails, the Yellow River and Luo will become one, the Clear Bian will no longer flow, and grain transport to the capital will be gravely imperiled.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day the emperor instructed the chief administrators: "The river sáo have long gone unrepaired. Yesterday word came that the Luo had again overflowed greatly and poured into the river. If the Guangwu sáo fails, the Yellow River and Luo will become one, the Clear Bian will no longer flow, and grain transport to the capital will be gravely imperiled.

sentences.zh: 宜亟命吳安持、王宗望同力督作，苟得不壞，過此須圖久計。」

translations.literal: You should urgently order Wu Anchi and Wang Zongwang to supervise the work together. If it can be kept from failing, we must afterward devise a lasting plan."
translations.idiomatic: You should urgently order Wu Anchi and Wang Zongwang to supervise the work together. If it can be kept from failing, we must afterward devise a lasting plan."

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吳安持言：「廣武第一埽危急，決口與清汴絕近，緣洛河之南，去廣武山千餘步，地形稍高。

translations.literal: On day bingyin Wu Anchi reported: "The first Guangwu sáo is in critical danger. The breach point is extremely close to the Clear Bian. Along the south bank of the Luo, about a thousand paces from Guangwu Mountain, the terrain is slightly higher.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Wu Anchi reported: "The first Guangwu sáo is in critical danger. The breach point is extremely close to the Clear Bian. Along the south bank of the Luo, about a thousand paces from Guangwu Mountain, the terrain is slightly higher.

sentences.zh: 自鞏縣東七里店至今洛口不滿十里，可以別開新河，導洛水近南行流，地里至少，用功甚微。」

translations.literal: From Qili Shop east of Gong County to the present Luo mouth is less than ten li. A new channel could be opened there to guide the Luo southward at close range, with very little distance and very slight labor."
translations.idiomatic: From Qili Shop east of Gong County to the present Luo mouth is less than ten li. A new channel could be opened there to guide the Luo southward at close range, with very little distance and very slight labor."

sentences.zh: 詔安持等再按視之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Anchi and his colleagues to investigate again.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Wu Anchi and his colleagues to reinvestigate the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十一月，李偉言：「清汴導溫洛貫京都，下通淮、泗，為萬世利。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Li Wei said: "The Clear Bian, guiding the warm Luo through the capital, connects downward to the Huai and Si — a benefit for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Li Wei submitted a memorial: "The Clear Bian draws the Luo through the capital and connects downstream to the Huai and Si rivers — a benefit for generations to come.

sentences.zh: 自元祐以來屢危急，而今歲特甚。

translations.literal: Since Yuanyou it has repeatedly been perilous, and this year is especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yuanyou era it has repeatedly been in crisis, and this year the danger is especially acute.

sentences.zh: 臣相視武濟山以下二十里名神尾山，乃廣武埽首所起，約置刺堰三里餘，就武濟河下尾廢堤、枯河基址增修疏導，回截河勢東北行，留舊埽作遙堤，可以紓清汴下注京城之患。」

translations.literal: Your subject inspected below Wuji Mountain for twenty li at a place called Shenwei Mountain — where the Guangwu sáo embankment begins — and proposes setting a spur dike about three li, augmenting and dredging on the abandoned dikes and dry riverbed at the lower tail of the Wuji River, turning and cutting the river force to run northeast, leaving the old sáo as a distant dike — this can relieve the calamity of the Clear Bian pouring down upon the capital."
translations.idiomatic: After surveying the twenty li below Wuji Mountain at a place called Shenwei Mountain, where the Guangwu sáo embankment begins, your subject proposes building a spur dike roughly three li long, dredging and reinforcing along the abandoned dikes and dry riverbed at the lower reach of the Wuji River, cutting the current so it runs northeast, and leaving the old sáo as a distant embankment — measures that would ease the danger of the Clear Bian pouring floodwater onto the capital."

sentences.zh: 詔宋用臣、陳祐甫覆按以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Song Yongchen and Chen Youfu to re-investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Song Yongchen and Chen Youfu to reinvestigate the proposal and report back.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，戶部尚書蔡京言：「本部歲計，皆藉東南漕運。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on day jiawu, Minister of Revenue Cai Jing said: "This ministry's annual accounts all depend on Southeast grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the twelfth month, Cai Jing, Minister of Revenue, memorialized: "This ministry's annual budget depends entirely on grain transport from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 今年上供物，至者十無二三，而汴口已閉。

translations.literal: This year's tribute goods — of those due, not even two or three in ten have arrived, yet the Bian mouth is already closed.
translations.idiomatic: This year barely two or three tenths of the tribute goods due have arrived, yet the Bian mouth has already been closed.

sentences.zh: 臣責問提舉汴河堤岸司楊琰，乃稱自元豐二年至元祐初，八年之間，未嘗塞也。」

translations.literal: Your subject questioned Yang Yan, intendant of the Bian River Dike and Bank Office, who said that from Yuanfeng year 2 to the beginning of Yuanyou — eight years — it had never been blocked."
translations.idiomatic: When questioned, Yang Yan, commissioner of the Bian River Dike and Bank Office, replied that from the second year of Yuanfeng through the early Yuanyou era — eight years in all — the channel had never been closed."

sentences.zh: 詔依元豐條例。

translations.literal: An edict ordered compliance with Yuanfeng regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered that Yuanfeng-era procedures be followed.

sentences.zh: 明年正月庚戌，用臣亦言：「元豐間，四月導洛通汴，六月放水，四時行流不絕。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year on day gengxu, Yongchen also said: "During Yuanfeng, in the fourth month the Luo was guided to connect with the Bian, in the sixth month water was released, and flow continued without cease through all four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the first month of the following year, Song Yongchen also memorialized: "During the Yuanfeng era, the Luo was diverted into the Bian in the fourth month and water was released in the sixth; the channel flowed without interruption throughout the year.

sentences.zh: 遇冬有凍，即督沿河官吏，伐冰通流。

translations.literal: When winter brought ice, officials along the river were immediately ordered to chop ice and open flow.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever ice formed in winter, officials along the river were ordered to break the ice and keep the water moving.

sentences.zh: 自元祐二年，冬深輒閉塞，致河流涸竭，殊失開導清汴本意。

translations.literal: Since Yuanyou year 2, in deep winter it was always blocked, causing the river to dry up — greatly losing the original intent of opening and guiding the Clear Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Since the second year of Yuanyou, the channel has been closed each deep winter, drying up the river and defeating the original purpose of the Clear Bian project.

sentences.zh: 今欲卜日伐冰，放水歸河，永不閉塞。

translations.literal: Now we wish to choose a day to chop ice, release water back to the river, and never block again.
translations.idiomatic: We propose to choose a day to break the ice, release water into the river, and never close the channel again.

sentences.zh: 及凍解，止將京西五斗門減放，以節水勢，如惠民河行流，自無壅遏之患。」

translations.literal: When the ice melts, only reduce release through the five Jingxi sluice gates to regulate water force — like the Huimin River's flow, there will naturally be no obstruction hazard."
translations.idiomatic: When the ice thaws, release would be reduced only through the five sluice gates in western Jing, moderating the flow as on the Huimin River, so there would be no risk of blockage."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊申，詔提舉河北西路常平李仲罷歸吏部。

translations.literal: In the first month on day wushen of the third year, an edict dismissed Li Zhong, intendant of Hebei West Circuit Ever-Normal Granaries, and returned him to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the first month of the third year, Li Zhong, commissioner of the Ever-Normal Granaries for Hebei West Circuit, was dismissed and returned to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 仲在元祐中提舉汜水輦運，建言：「西京、鞏縣、河陽、汜水、河陰縣界，乃沿黃河地分，北有太行、南有廣武二山，自古河流兩山之間，乃緣禹跡。

translations.literal: Zhong, while intendant of Sishui transport in Yuanyou, proposed: "The boundaries of Xijing, Gong County, Heyang, Sishui, and Heyin — Yellow River-front territory — have the Taihang to the north and Guangwu Mountain to the south; from antiquity the river has run between the two mountains, following Yu's track.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as commissioner of Sishui transport during Yuanyou, Li Zhong proposed: "The territory along the Yellow River between Xijing, Gong County, Heyang, Sishui, and Heyin lies between the Taihang Range to the north and Guangwu Mountain to the south; since antiquity the river has followed this course between the two ranges, along the path traced by Yu the Great.

sentences.zh: 昨自宋用臣創置導洛清汴，于黃河沙灘上，節次創置廣、雄武等堤埽，到今十餘年間，屢經危急。

translations.literal: Since Song Yongchen created the guide-Luo Clear-Bian project on the Yellow River sand flats, successively creating Guang, Xiongwu, and other dikes and sáo — in the more than ten years to now it has repeatedly faced peril.
translations.idiomatic: Since Song Yongchen established the guide-Luo Clear-Bian system on the Yellow River's sandy flats and successively built the Guang, Xiongwu, and other dikes and sáo embankments, the project has repeatedly faced crisis over the past dozen years.

sentences.zh: 況諸埽在京城之上，若不別為之計，患起不測，思之寒心。

translations.literal: Moreover the various sáo lie above the capital; if no separate plan is made, calamity may arise unpredictably — thinking of it chills the heart.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since these sáo embankments stand upstream of the capital, failure to devise another plan could bring disaster without warning — a prospect that chills the heart.

sentences.zh: 今如棄去諸埽，開展河道，講究興復元豐二年以前防河事，不惟省歲費、寬民力，河流且無壅遏決溢之患。

translations.literal: Now if the various sáo are abandoned, the river channel expanded, and restoration of pre-Yuanfeng year 2 river-control measures is pursued — not only saving annual costs and easing the people's labor, the river would also be free of obstruction and breach overflow calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If the sáo embankments were abandoned, the channel widened, and river-control measures from before the second year of Yuanfeng restored, annual costs would be saved, the people's burden eased, and the river would be free of blockage, breach, and overflow.

sentences.zh: 望遣諳河事官相視施行。」

translations.literal: I hope officials versed in river affairs will be sent to inspect and implement."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that officials experienced in river management be dispatched to survey the site and carry out the plan."

sentences.zh: 又乞復置汴口，依舊以黃河水為節約之限，罷去清汴閘口。

translations.literal: He also begged to restore the Bian mouth, again using Yellow River water as the limit for regulation, and abolishing the Clear Bian sluice mouth.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested restoration of the Bian mouth, with Yellow River water again serving as the regulatory limit, and abolition of the Clear Bian sluice.

sentences.zh: 四年閏二月，楊琰乞依元豐例，減放洛水入京西界大白龍坑及三十六陂，充水匱以助汴河行運。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of the fourth year, Yang Yan requested following the Yuanfeng precedent to reduce and release Luo water into the Great White Dragon Pit and Thirty-Six Ponds in western Jing territory, filling water reservoirs to assist Bian River transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of the fourth year, Yang Yan requested that Luo water be released, following Yuanfeng precedent, into the Great White Dragon Pit and the Thirty-Six Ponds in western Jing, filling storage basins to support transport on the Bian.

sentences.zh: 詔賈種民同琰相度合占頃畝，及所用功力以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jia Zhongmin together with Yan to survey jointly occupied acreage and labor required and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Jia Zhongmin and Yang Yan to survey the land involved and the labor required, and report back.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，都提舉汴河堤岸賈種民言：「元豐改汴口為洛口，名汴河為清汴者，凡以取水於洛也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on day yihai, Chief Intendant of Bian River Dikes and Banks Jia Zhongmin said: "In Yuanfeng the Bian mouth was changed to the Luo mouth and the Bian River named Clear Bian — all to take water from the Luo.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the fifth month, Jia Zhongmin, chief commissioner of the Bian River Dike and Bank Office, memorialized: "In Yuanfeng the Bian mouth was converted to the Luo mouth and the canal renamed the Clear Bian — entirely so that water could be drawn from the Luo.

sentences.zh: 復匱清水，以備淺澀而助行流。

translations.literal: Reservoirs were also filled with clear water to guard against shoals and assist flow.
translations.idiomatic: Clear-water reservoirs were also maintained to guard against shallow stretches and sustain the current.

sentences.zh: 元祐間，卻于黃河撥口，分引渾水，令自笧上流入洛口，比之清洛，難以調節。

translations.literal: During Yuanyou, instead a breach was opened in the Yellow River to divide and draw muddy water, letting it flow from bamboo sluices into the Luo mouth — compared with clear Luo water, hard to regulate.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanyou, however, a breach was opened in the Yellow River to divert muddy water through bamboo sluices into the Luo mouth — far harder to regulate than the clear Luo.

sentences.zh: 乞依元豐已修狹河身丈尺深淺，檢計物力，以復清汴，立限修浚，通放洛水。

translations.literal: I beg to follow Yuanfeng's already repaired narrow channel dimensions of depth and breadth, calculate material and labor, restore the Clear Bian, set a deadline for dredging, and release Luo water through.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the channel be restored to the width and depth repaired under Yuanfeng, that resources be calculated, dredging completed on a fixed schedule, and Luo water released through the Clear Bian once more.

sentences.zh: 及依舊置洛斗門，通放西河官私舟船。」

translations.literal: And to restore the Luo sluice gates as before, releasing official and private boats on the western river."
translations.idiomatic: The Luo sluice gates should also be restored as before to allow official and private vessels on the western river to pass."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗謂知樞密院事曾布曰：「先帝作清汴，又為天源河，蓋有深意。

translations.literal: The emperor once said to Zeng Bu, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs: "The late emperor made the Clear Bian and also the Tianyuan River — surely with deep purpose.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once said to Zeng Bu, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs: "The late emperor created the Clear Bian and the Tianyuan River for deep and deliberate reasons.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，幾廢。

translations.literal: In Yuanyou it was nearly abolished.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanyou the projects nearly came to an end.

sentences.zh: 近賈種民奏：'若盡復清汴，不用濁流，乃當世靈長之慶。」

translations.literal: Recently Jia Zhongmin memorialized: 'If the Clear Bian is fully restored and muddy flow is not used, it will be a blessing of enduring fortune for this age.'"
translations.idiomatic: Recently Jia Zhongmin memorialized: 'If the Clear Bian is fully restored and muddy water abandoned, it will be a blessing of enduring fortune for our age.'"

sentences.zh: 布對曰：「先帝以天源河為國姓福地，此眾人所知，何可廢也。」

translations.literal: Bu replied: "The late emperor took the Tianyuan River as the felicitous ground of the imperial surname — this all know; how could it be abolished?"
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu replied: "The late emperor regarded the Tianyuan River as felicitous ground for the imperial surname — this is widely known. How could it be abandoned?"

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔：「京城內汴河兩岸，各留堤面丈有五尺，禁公私侵牟。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict: "On both banks of the Bian within the capital, leave a dike surface of one zhang and five chi on each side; public and private encroachment is forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict declared: "On both banks of the Bian within the capital, a dike surface of one zhang and five chi shall be reserved on each side; public and private encroachment is forbidden."

sentences.zh: 元符三年，徽宗即位，無大改作，汴渠稍湮則浚之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfu, Huizong ascended; there were no major reworkings — when the Bian canal silted slightly, it was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfu, when Huizong ascended the throne, no major changes were made; when the Bian canal silted up, it was simply dredged.

sentences.zh: 大觀中，言者論：「胡師文昨為發運使，創開泗州直河，及築簽堤阻遏汴水，尋復淤澱，遂行廢拆。

translations.literal: During Daguan, memorialists argued: "Hu Shiwen, formerly transport commissioner, newly opened the Sizhou straight channel and built spur dikes blocking the Bian water; soon it silted again and was abolished and dismantled.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daguan era, critics charged: "When Hu Shiwen served as transport commissioner, he opened a straight channel at Sizhou and built spur dikes that blocked the Bian; the channel soon silted up again and the works were dismantled.

sentences.zh: 然後並役數郡兵夫，其間疾苦竄歿，無慮數千，費錢谷累百萬計。

translations.literal: Yet conscripted laborers from several prefectures — among them suffering, fleeing, and dying numbered no less than several thousand; money and grain cost accumulated to over a million.
translations.idiomatic: Yet laborers were conscripted from several prefectures; thousands suffered, fled, or died in the process, and costs in money and grain ran to well over a million.

sentences.zh: 狂妄生事，誣奏罔功，官員冒賞至四十五人。」

translations.literal: Recklessly creating affairs, falsely memorializing and claiming merit without cause — officials fraudulently rewarded reached forty-five persons."
translations.idiomatic: Recklessly initiating the project, falsely reporting success, officials fraudulently rewarded numbered as many as forty-five."

sentences.zh: 師文由是自知州降充宮觀。

translations.literal: Shiwen was thereby demoted from prefect to nominal palace-attendant status.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shiwen was demoted from prefect to a nominal palace-attendant post.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年五月，都城無故大水，浸城外官寺、民居，遂破汴堤，汴渠將溢，諸門皆城守。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Xuanhe, the capital without cause suffered great flood, soaking official temples and common dwellings outside the walls; the Bian dike was breached, the Bian canal nearly overflowed, and all gates manned the walls in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Xuanhe, the capital was inundated without apparent cause, flooding official temples and private dwellings outside the walls; the Bian dike broke, the canal nearly overflowed, and every gate was manned in defense.

sentences.zh: 起居郎李綱奏：「國家都汴，百有六十餘載，未嘗少有變故。

translations.literal: Attendant Li Gang memorialized: "The state has had its capital at Bian for over one hundred and sixty years, never once suffering even slight disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang, Attendant of the Left, memorialized: "The dynasty has held its capital at Bian for more than one hundred and sixty years without ever suffering a disaster of this kind.

sentences.zh: 今事起倉猝，遐邇驚駭，誠大異也。

translations.literal: Now the affair arose in haste; near and far are alarmed — truly a great anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: That this should arise so suddenly, alarming the realm near and far, is truly extraordinary.

sentences.zh: 臣嘗躬詣郊外，竊見積水之來，自都城以西，漫為巨浸。

translations.literal: Your subject once went in person to the suburbs and secretly saw the accumulated water coming — from west of the capital it spread into a vast flood.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject went in person to the suburbs and saw the floodwaters spreading from west of the capital into a vast inundation.

sentences.zh: 東拒汴堤，停蓄深廣，湍悍浚激，東南而流，其勢未艾。

translations.literal: Eastward blocked by the Bian dike, stored deep and broad, turbulently fierce and scouring, flowing southeast — its force not yet spent.
translations.idiomatic: Blocked to the east by the Bian dike, the water pooled deep and wide, then surged turbulently southeastward with undiminished force.

sentences.zh: 然或淹浸旬時，因以風雨，不可不慮。

translations.literal: Yet if submerged for ten days, compounded by wind and rain — this must be considered.
translations.idiomatic: If the inundation lasts ten days or more, especially with wind and rain, the danger cannot be ignored.

sentences.zh: 夫變不虛發，必有感召之因。

translations.literal: Calamities do not arise without cause; there must be inciting factors.
translations.idiomatic: Extraordinary events do not occur without cause; there must be provoking factors behind them.

sentences.zh: 願詔廷臣各具所見，擇其可采者施行之。」

translations.literal: I wish the court would instruct ministers each to set forth their views, choose what can be adopted, and implement it."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the court summon ministers to submit their views and implement whatever proves useful."

sentences.zh: 詔：「都城外積水，緣有司失職，堤防不修，非災異也。」

translations.literal: An edict: "Accumulated water outside the capital is because officials were derelict and dikes were not maintained — this is not a calamitous portent."
translations.idiomatic: The court replied: "The flood outside the capital stems from official neglect and unmaintained dikes — not from a heavenly portent."

sentences.zh: 罷綱送吏部，而募人決水下流，由城北注五丈河，下通梁山濼，乃已。

translations.literal: Officials responsible were dismissed and sent to the Ministry of Personnel; laborers were hired to cut the water downstream, from north of the city pouring into the Wuzhang River, connecting down to Liangshan Marsh — then it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Responsible officials were dismissed and referred to the Ministry of Personnel; hired laborers were set to cut a channel downstream, directing water from north of the city into the Wuzhang River and thence to Liangshan Marsh, after which the flood subsided.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，都提舉司言：「近因野水沖蕩沿汴堤岸，及河道淤淺，若止役河清，功力不勝，望俟農隙顧夫開修。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month on day renzi, the Chief Intendant Office said: "Recently wild water scoured Bian dikes and banks along the route, and the channel silted shallow; if only Heqing labor is used, strength will not suffice — we hope to wait for a farming interval and mobilize labor to open and repair."
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the seventh month, the chief intendant's office reported: "Recent floodwaters have scoured dikes and banks along the Bian, and the channel has silted up; labor from Heqing alone would not suffice. We ask to wait until the farming slack season to mobilize workers for dredging and repair."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月庚寅，詔：「沿汴州縣創添欄河鎖柵歲額，公私不以為便，其遵元豐舊制。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on day gengyin of the fifth year, an edict: "Prefectures and counties along the Bian newly added river-bar lock-fence annual quotas — public and private find them inconvenient; follow Yuanfeng old regulations."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the twelfth month of the fifth year, an edict declared: "New annual quotas for river-bar locks and fences imposed on prefectures and counties along the Bian have proved burdensome; the Yuanfeng regulations shall be restored."

sentences.zh: 靖康而後，汴河上流為盜所決者數處，決口有至百步者，塞久不合，乾涸月餘，綱運不通，南京及京師皆乏糧。

translations.literal: After Jingkang, the upper Bian River was breached by bandits in several places; some breaches reached a hundred paces; blocked long without closing, dried up for over a month, transport boats could not pass — Nanjing and the capital both lacked grain.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jingkang disaster, bandits breached the upper Bian in several places; some breaks reached a hundred paces wide. The breaches remained open for so long that the canal dried up for more than a month, transport ceased, and both Nanjing and the capital faced grain shortages.

sentences.zh: 責都水使者措置，凡二十餘日而水復舊，綱運遝來，兩京糧始足。

translations.literal: The Director of Water Affairs was charged to arrange matters; in a little over twenty days water returned to normal, transport boats came in succession, and both capitals' grain was finally sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Water Affairs was ordered to remedy the situation; within twenty-odd days the water returned to normal, transport convoys arrived in succession, and grain supplies in both capitals were restored.

sentences.zh: 又擇使臣八員為沿汴巡檢，每兩員各將兵五百人，自洛口至西水門，分地防察決溢雲。

translations.literal: Eight envoy-officials were also chosen as Bian-route inspectors; every two, each leading five hundred soldiers from the Luo mouth to the Xishui Gate, divided territory to guard against breaches and overflows.
translations.idiomatic: Eight envoy-officials were also appointed as inspectors along the Bian; every pair, each commanding five hundred soldiers from the Luo mouth to the Xishui Gate, patrolled assigned sections to guard against breaches and overflows.

sentences.zh: 洛水貫西京，多暴漲，漂壞橋樑。

translations.literal: The Luo River runs through Xijing; it often surges violently and washes away bridges.
translations.idiomatic: The Luo River runs through Xijing and often floods violently, destroying bridges.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，留守向拱重修天津橋成。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, garrison commander Xiang Gong completed rebuilding the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianlong, Xiang Gong, military commissioner of the western capital, completed reconstruction of the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 甃巨石為腳，高數丈，銳其前以疏水勢，石縱縫以鐵鼓絡之，其制甚固。

translations.literal: Giant stones were laid as footings, several zhang high; the front was sharpened to spread water force; stones in vertical joints were bound with iron hoops — the structure very solid.
translations.idiomatic: Massive stones were laid as footings several zhang high, their upstream faces angled to break the current; vertical joints were bound with iron hoops — a structure of great solidity.

sentences.zh: 四月，具圖來上，降詔褒美。

translations.literal: In the fourth month diagrams were submitted; an edict was issued praising the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he submitted detailed plans and received an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 開寶九年，郊祀西京，詔發卒五千，自洛城菜市橋鑿渠抵漕口三十五里，饋運便之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kaibao, when performing suburban sacrifice at Xijing, an edict mobilized five thousand soldiers to cut a canal from Luocheng's Caishi Bridge to the transport mouth — thirty-five li — for convenient supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Kaibao, when performing the suburban sacrifice at the western capital, five thousand soldiers were mobilized to cut a canal thirty-five li from the Caishi Bridge in Luocheng to the transport mouth, easing supply transport.

sentences.zh: 其後導以通汴。

translations.literal: Afterward it was guided to connect with the Bian.
translations.idiomatic: It was later connected to the Bian Canal.

sentences.zh: 蔡河貫京師，為都人所仰，兼閔水、洧水、潩水以通舟。

translations.literal: The Cai River runs through the capital; the capital people rely on it, combining Min, Wei, and Yi waters to connect boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Cai River runs through the capital and supplies the city's needs, drawing together the Min, Wei, and Yi rivers for navigation.

sentences.zh: 閔水自尉氏歷祥符、開封合于蔡，是為惠民河。

translations.literal: Min River from Weishi through Xiangfu and Kaifeng joins the Cai — this is the Huimin River.
translations.idiomatic: The Min River flows from Weishi through Xiangfu and Kaifeng to join the Cai — the Huimin River.

sentences.zh: 洧水自許田注鄢陵東南，曆扶溝合于蔡。

translations.literal: Wei River from Xutian flows into the southeast of Yanling, passing through Fugou to join the Cai.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei River rises at Xutian, flows into southeastern Yanling, passes through Fugou, and joins the Cai.

sentences.zh: 潩水出鄭之大隗山，注臨潁，曆鄢陵、扶溝合于蔡。

translations.literal: Yi River emerges from Da Wei Mountain in Zheng, flows into Linying, passes through Yanling and Fugou to join the Cai.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi River rises on Da Wei Mountain in Zheng, flows to Linying, passes through Yanling and Fugou, and joins the Cai.

sentences.zh: 凡許、鄭諸水合堅白雁、丈八溝，京、索合西河、褚河、湖河、雙河、欒霸河皆會焉。

translations.literal: All waters of Xu and Zheng combine with Jianbaiyan and Zhangba Ditch; Jing and Suo combine with Xi River, Chu River, Hu River, Shuang River, and Luanba River — all meeting there.
translations.idiomatic: The rivers of Xu and Zheng, together with the Jianbaiyan and Zhangba Ditches, and the Jing and Suo rivers with the Xi, Chu, Hu, Shuang, and Luanba rivers, all converge there.

sentences.zh: 猶以其淺涸，故植木橫棧；

translations.literal: Still because it was shallow and dry, wooden cross-bars were planted;
translations.idiomatic: Because the channel was often shallow, wooden cross-bars were installed;

sentences.zh: 棧為水之節，啟閉以時。

translations.literal: the bars served as water regulators, opened and closed according to season.
translations.idiomatic: these bars regulated the flow, opened and closed according to season.

sentences.zh: 太祖四月，命中使浚蔡河，設斗門節水，自京距通許鎮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month under Taizu, palace envoys were ordered to dredge the Cai River, set sluice gates to regulate water, from the capital to Tongxu Town.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month under Taizu, palace envoys were ordered to dredge the Cai River and set sluice gates to regulate the flow from the capital to Tongxu Town.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔發畿甸、陳、許丁夫數萬浚蔡水，南入潁川。

translations.literal: In the second year an edict mobilized tens of thousands of corvée laborers from the capital region, Chen, and Xu to dredge Cai water south into Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict mobilized tens of thousands of corvée laborers from the capital region, Chen, and Xu to dredge the Cai south into Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年二月，令陳承昭率丁夫數千鑿渠，自長社引潩水至京師，合閔水。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Qiande, Chen Chengzhao was ordered to lead several thousand laborers to cut a channel drawing Yi water from Changshe to the capital to join the Min River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Qiande, Chen Chengzhao was ordered to lead several thousand laborers to cut a channel drawing Yi water from Changshe to the capital to join the Min River.

sentences.zh: 渠成，潩水本出密縣大隗山，曆許田。

translations.literal: When the channel was completed, the Yi River originally rose on Da Wei Mountain in Mi County and passed through Xutian fields.
translations.idiomatic: When the channel was completed, the Yi River originally rose on Da Wei Mountain in Mi County and passed through Xutian fields.

sentences.zh: 會春夏霖雨，則泛溢民田。

translations.literal: When spring and summer brought heavy rains, it would overflow onto commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: When spring and summer brought heavy rains, it would overflow onto commoners' fields.

sentences.zh: 至是渠成，無水患，閔河益通漕焉。

translations.literal: Now that the channel was completed there was no flood hazard, and the Min River better served transport.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the channel was completed there was no flood hazard, and the Min River better served transport.

sentences.zh: 太宗淳化二年，以潩水泛溢，浸許州民田，詔自長葛縣開小河，導潩水，分流二十里，合于惠民河。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua under Taizong, because Yi River overflowed and soaked Xuzhou commoners' fields, an edict ordered opening a small channel from Changge County to guide Yi water, dividing flow for twenty li to join the Huimin River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunhua, because the Yi River overflowed and flooded farmland in Xuzhou, the court ordered a small canal cut from Changge County to divert the Yi twenty li into the Huimin River.

sentences.zh: 真宗七月，京師霖雨，溝洫壅，惠民河溢，泛道路，壞廬舍，知開封府寇准治丁岡古河泄導之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month under Zhenzong, heavy rains in the capital clogged ditches, the Huimin River overflowed, flooded the roads, and ruined dwellings; Kou Zhun, prefect of Kaifeng, dredged the ancient Dinggang River to drain and guide the water.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month under Zhenzong, heavy rains in the capital clogged ditches, the Huimin River overflowed, flooded the roads, and ruined dwellings; Kou Zhun, prefect of Kaifeng, dredged the ancient Dinggang River to drain and guide the water.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年六月，開封府言：「尉氏縣惠民河決。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Kaifeng Prefecture reported: "The Huimin River breached in Weishi County."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Kaifeng Prefecture reported: "The Huimin River breached in Weishi County."

sentences.zh: 遣使督視完塞。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to supervise inspection and complete the repair.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to supervise inspection and complete the repair.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，陳州言：「州地洿下，苦積潦，歲有水患，請自許州長葛縣浚減水河及補棗村舊河，以入蔡河。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Chen Prefecture reported: "The prefecture lies low and suffers standing water; every year there is flood hazard. We ask to dredge a flood-reduction channel from Changge County in Xuzhou and restore the old channel at Zaocun to enter the Cai River."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, Chen Prefecture reported: "The prefecture lies low and suffers standing water; every year there is flood hazard. We ask to dredge a flood-reduction channel from Changge County in Xuzhou and restore the old channel at Zaocun to enter the Cai River."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 九年，知許州石普請於大流堰穿渠，置二斗門，引沙河以漕京師。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Shi Pu, prefect of Xuzhou, requested cutting a channel through the Daliu Weir, setting two sluice gates, and drawing Sha River water to transport grain to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Shi Pu, prefect of Xuzhou, requested cutting a channel through the Daliu Weir, setting two sluice gates, and drawing Sha River water to transport grain to the capital.

sentences.zh: 遣使按視。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to inspect.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔遣中使至惠民河，規畫置壩子，以通舟運。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict dispatched palace envoys to the Huimin River to plan and set weirs to open boat transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict dispatched palace envoys to the Huimin River to plan and set weirs to open boat transport.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖二年二月，崇儀副使、巡護惠民河田承說獻議：重修許州合流鎮大流堰斗門，創開減水河通漕，省迂路五百里。
